skill.name: fundamentals-gate
skill.description: Review code fundamentals such as naming, function focus, reuse, structure, and comments. The skill returns pass or suggestions, not blocking failures.

content.value_statement: Small readability problems make code reviews slower and harder to maintain. This skill reviews naming, structure, reuse, and comments so Claude, Codex, or Claude Code can return clear pass or suggestion guidance.
actual_capabilities: Checks variable, boolean, function, constant, and class naming against readable naming patterns.
Reviews function focus, approximate size, parameter count, nesting, and hidden side effects.
Identifies repeated patterns that may benefit from extraction after enough duplication appears.
Evaluates comments for useful intent and flags obvious or commented-out code.
Returns either a pass status or concise suggestions with practical reasons.
limitations: It gives suggestions and does not act as a mandatory release blocker.
It does not run tests, linters, type checkers, or security scanners.
Referenced standards paths are not included in this skill package.
It is not a substitute for domain-specific architecture or performance review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Check naming, function focus, comments, and duplication before requesting a full review.

use_cases.title: Coach Junior Engineers
use_cases.description: Turn unclear code into learning suggestions that explain readability and maintainability tradeoffs.

use_cases.title: Standardize Review Feedback
use_cases.description: Use a consistent fundamentals checklist across teams without making style polish a hard blocker.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Fundamentals Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when reviewing a small change for readability.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change with the fundamentals gate. Check naming, function focus, structure, comments, and reuse. Return PASS or SUGGESTIONS.

prompt_templates.title: Pull Request Polish Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before sending a pull request to human reviewers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the fundamentals checklist to this pull request. Separate must-fix concerns from polish suggestions. Keep each suggestion brief and actionable.

prompt_templates.title: Mentoring Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when feedback should teach the reasoning behind changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this code as a mentor. Ask Socratic fundamentals questions for unclear naming, large functions, duplication, comments, and magic values.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Consistency Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when checking a larger module or feature branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this module against nearby conventions. Identify naming drift, repeated patterns, function scope issues, comment quality, and structure concerns. Prioritize suggestions by impact.

output_examples.input: Review a small helper module that uses clear names and focused functions.
output_examples.output: FUNDAMENTALS GATE: PASSED. Naming is clear, functions are focused, duplication is low, and comments explain intent where needed.

output_examples.input: Review a service file with vague names, long functions, and repeated validation logic.
output: Naming: Replace vague temporary names with domain terms.
Function focus: Split the largest workflow into validation, calculation, and persistence steps.
Reuse: Extract repeated validation only if the same rule appears in several places.

output_examples.input: Review a prototype where speed matters more than polish.
output_examples.output: FUNDAMENTALS GATE: SUGGESTIONS. Note the readability issues, but do not block delivery when the tradeoff is intentional.

best_practices: Provide the surrounding files or conventions so suggestions match the existing codebase.
Ask for pass or suggestions before a full code review to keep feedback focused.
Treat each recommendation as a maintainability tradeoff, not an automatic rewrite request.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as the only security, correctness, or production readiness review.
Do not apply every suggestion when local conventions intentionally differ.
Do not ask it to rewrite large modules without naming the review priorities.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews naming, function focus, duplication, structure, comments, and common readability patterns.

faq.question: Does it block code from shipping?
faq.answer: No. The skill treats fundamentals issues as suggestions unless the user asks for stricter policy.

faq.question: Can it replace linters or tests?
faq.answer: No. It provides qualitative review guidance and does not execute automated checks.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful for mentoring?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Socratic questions that help engineers reason about readability choices.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the changed files, nearby conventions, and any intentional tradeoffs that affect readability.
